items.title: Launching Sora responsibly
items.summary: To address the novel safety challenges posed by a state-of-the-art video model as well as a new social creation platform, we’ve built Sora 2 and the Sora app with safety at the foundation. Our approach is anchored in concrete protections.
items.summaryZh: 为应对最先进视频生成模型及社交创作平台带来的新型安全挑战，OpenAI发布了Sora 2及配套应用。新模型在保障安全底线的基础上构建，采取了一系列具体的保护措施，标志着视频AI生成技术正走向更成熟的商用与社区生态。

aiReview.reasonZh: OpenAI正式推出Sora 2及社交应用并公布安全应对策略，是多模态视频生成模型的重要发布。

items.title: Sora 2 System Card
items.summary: Sora 2 is our new state of the art video and audio generation model. Building on the foundation of Sora, this new model introduces capabilities that have been difficult for prior video models to achieve– such as more accurate physics, sharper realism, synchronized audio, enhanced steerability, and an expanded stylistic range.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI发布Sora 2系统卡，介绍其为全新的顶尖视频和音频生成模型。该模型在物理真实感、画面锐度、同步音频、可控性及风格扩展性上取得了前代模型难以企及的突破，为多模态生成树立了新标杆。原始信息显示：Sora 2 is our new state of the art video and audio generation model. Building on the foundation of Sora, this new model introduces capabilities that have been difficult for prior video models to achieve– such as more accurate physics, sharper realism, synchronized audio, enhanced steerability, and an expanded stylistic range.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“Sora 2 System Card”。其重要性主要体现在：Sora 2系统卡的发布详细披露了该顶尖视频与音频生成模型的核心能力升级与物理模拟特性。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。

items.title: Sora 2 is here
items.summary: This post introduced Sora 2, a video generation model with synchronized dialogue and sound effects. The Sora product is no longer available.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI正式推出Sora 2视频生成模型，该模型不仅在画质和动态表现上有所升级，更引入了同步对话与音效生成能力，标志着多模态视频大模型向更成熟的视听一体化方向演进，同时原有的Sora产品宣告下架。原始信息显示：This post introduced Sora 2, a video generation model with synchronized dialogue and sound effects. The Sora product is no longer available.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“Sora 2 is here”。其重要性主要体现在：OpenAI发布了支持同步对话与音效的新一代视频生成模型Sora 2，具有重要的模型迭代与行业风向意义。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
